Aisha (Design): quick design pass for the trace drilldown modal. uploaded compact + wide variants: https://figma.com/file/trace-drilldown - want feedback on copy and keyboard behavior :eyes:
Aisha (Design): core goal: surface request metadata + error stack without pushing the trace off-screen on small laptops. also need export affordance that communicates format.
Tom (Eng): first glance looks good. question: when frames are collapsed, how does keyboard-only user expand the 3-dot menu for frame actions?
Lena (Eng-UX): add `aria-haspopup=menu` and ensure menu button is in tab order. Also provide a visible focus ring for the menu button and allow Enter/Space to open.
Tom (Eng): good. for copy interactions (correlation ID + frame source link) prefer role=button + `aria-pressed`? maybe `aria-label` + `aria-describedby` to indicate success message container.
Aisha (Design): re microcopy: replacing "Show stack" with "Expand frames" and "Export" with a split control. is everyone aligned?
Ravi (Product): split control makes sense. also suggest explicit format in menu: "Export trace (HAR)", "Export trace (JSON)" - avoids confusion. we'll log export format as metric.
Lena (Eng-UX): accessibility notes: timestamp text contrast fails for 12px. propose swapping the grey from #6b7280 to #4b5563, or increase font from 12px to 13px. also add `aria-live="polite"` region for toast copy confirmations.
Tom (Eng): implementation note: clipboard API `navigator.clipboard.writeText(id)` + throw-friendly fallback to legacy execCommand for older browsers in the private deployment UI. make sure to catch and surface errors to telemetry.
Aisha (Design): thinking about collapsed-by-default rule: traces > 8 frames collapse and we show "Expand frames (8)". It reads as "Expand frames (8)" where parenthesis is count, good?
Ravi (Product): yes use `Expand frames (8)` — product wants `(8)` visible. we can A/B test collapsed vs expanded for triage speed.
Lena (Eng-UX): also recommend a skip link `Skip to frames` at top of modal for screen readers to jump past metadata. include `href="#frames"` and visually hide it but make visible on focus.
Tom (Eng): about export route naming: backend currently exposes `/trace/:id/export`. product wants `/trace/:id/download` in docs. we should keep backend stable but alias `download` for API docs clarity.
ops-bot: Accessibility scan: 3 warnings  contrast 1, missing aria-expanded 2. CI: https://ci.internal/scan/1780
Aisha (Design): I'll update Figma and post keyboard flow screenshots, plus add tooltip states for copy button.
Tom (Eng): I'll implement ARIA attributes and the copy toast. planning to PR early next week.
Ravi (Product): I'll add the export format metrics and the A/B test card to backlog.
Lena (Eng-UX): updated figma comments with alt text for timeline SVG bars and suggested focus outlines.
Aisha (Design): thanks team :heart: will loop back.
